description:
Because:
- fxa-shared/tracing duplicates @fxa/shared/otel.
- The fxa-shared copy imports ../sentry, which blocks the sentry move.

This commit:
- Replaces tracing/config.ts and node-tracing.ts with re-exports of @fxa/shared/otel.
- Deletes tracing/pii-filters.ts, tracing/exporters/ and test/tracing/.
- Ports the config and exporters tests to jest in libs/shared/otel.
- Keeps profile-server otel.concurrencyLimit at 10 in lib/config.js.
- Adds lib/config.spec.ts in profile-server for the default and the env override.

Closes FXA-10674
